actions.objective: Download the referenced YouTube video, extract the full ordered list of player inputs/moves from the video, and write /app/solution.txt with one move per line.
required_artifacts: a local copy or verified download of the referenced video
an extracted move list matching the video
required_behaviors: Use evidence-backed inspection of the video contents before writing the solution file.
Preserve the exact move order as shown in the video.
Format each move on its own line in /app/solution.txt.
known_invalid_patterns: Guessing or inventing moves without video evidence.
Treating file existence or non-empty output as sufficient.
Using partial transcript or partial move list as final output.
verification_plan: Acquire the video or a verifiable local copy.
Extract the move sequence from the video contents.
Write /app/solution.txt with one move per line.
Verify the written file matches the extracted move list.
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence of the downloaded/verified video copy.
Receipt-backed evidence of the extracted move list from the video.
Receipt-backed evidence showing /app/solution.txt contains the same ordered moves.

actions.command: pwd && ls -la && command -v yt-dlp || true && command -v youtube-dl || true && command -v ffmpeg || true && command -v python3 || true
